modelSelectionRationale: Deployment & Engineering Trade-Off: In validation benchmarking, LinearSVC_Calibrated_OvR (Macro F1: 0.6763, Micro F1: 0.7933) achieved slightly higher raw ranking performance than LogisticRegression_OvR (Macro F1: 0.6226, Micro F1: 0.6808). However, LogisticRegression_OvR was selected as the deployed production model because it produces pure, closed-form independent sigmoid probabilities (P = 1 / (1 + e^-z)) with direct linear weight matrix export (W, b). This guarantees exact bit-level numerical parity between Python training and the Node.js serving runtime (delta < 1e-15), whereas multi-fold CalibratedClassifierCV requires non-parametric sigmoid piecewise calibrators that introduce runtime serving divergence.
